Accomplishment
1. Professor of Business and Analytics, Teaching MBA and Executive MBA Courses for Working Professionals in Silicon Valley

2. Department Chair of Information Systems & Analytics (ISA) in the Leavey School of Business at Santa Clara Univ. 2010-2017

3. Recipient of the Wickham Skinner Award for Teaching Innovation from the Production & Operations Management Society (POMS) 2007

4. Eight-time Recipient of the Leavey School of Business Dean’s Award for Extraordinary Performance in Research, Teaching, and Service

5. Renowned lecturer to Academic and Industry Audiences throughout North America, Europe, and Asia

6. Holds Senior Leadership Positions for Several Top-Level Journals in Business Management Fields

7. Has Been Interviewed Extensively in the Global Media, Including by The New York Times, Voice of America, and CCTV

8. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 01/2019
